test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the directions given by the coach, Jhulan walks 7 metres to the south-east from point X. Then Jhulan walks 14 metres to the west. She then walks 7 metres to the north-west. Finally, Jhulan walks 4 metres to the east and reaches point Y. What is the shortest distance between X and Y?
solution:
**Explanation:**

 
• Jhulan walks 7 metres to the south-east from point X.
 
• Then Jhulan walks 14 metres to the west.
 
• She then walks 7 metres to the north-west. 
 
• Jhulan walks 4 metres to the east and reaches point Y.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76db12fb02efaa50f7fb684be84282ce26dfdd086fa432298cd384de6bac0edc.png] 

**10 metres **is the shortest distance between X and Y.

Hence, **10 metres **is the** correct answer.**
